title: Gasometer

inlines.v: GASOM'ETER, noun [gas] In chimistry, an instrument or apparatus, intended to measure, collect, preserve or mix different gases. An instrument for measuring the quantity of gas employed in an experiment; also, the place where gas is prepared for lighting streets.
